::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [late 1860s?]  
**From:** Crookham  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear[Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd)

Thank you for your letter, which I found here when I arrived yesterday, by way of Salisbury and Basingstoke. I meant all those flowers of which there was but one specimen for you, [Helen](people/person_1613.qmd) may wait to collect for herself

Your most affectionate

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Dated on the assumption that it was written when Helen Yonge was a small child beginning a collection of pressed flowers.
